rachel_sales: Halcyon POC is hitting failures during rerank. They POST candidates and get a 400 dims mismatch + occasional 413. Can we triage? :mag:
devin_infra: Can you paste the error and a sanitized request?
rachel_sales: Sent the stack Jordan from Halcyon provided:
````
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"query_embedding\": [0.02, 0.11, ..., 0.08],
  \"candidates\": [[...], [...]],
  \"model\": \"rerank-xl\"
}

HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  \"error\": \"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1024, got 512\"
}
````
mia_ml: Expected 1024 is the reranker shape. Their vectors are 512. Could be they use an internal compact embed or they're accidentally hashing/compressing.
jules_se: Two concurrent signals: dims mismatch + 413 Payload Too Large when they tried sending 8k candidates. For rerank we should recommend smaller payloads and pre-filter client-side.
rachel_sales: Halcyon says they use an internal embedding called \"hal-embed-small\" that returns 512 floats. They also mentioned some clients batch multiple JSON arrays and sometimes base64-encode binary arrays.
devin_infra: Base64-encoded vectors would show up as strings in the payload and would cause parsing or dimension errors if decoded wrongly. Ask for raw JSON of one failing candidate payload. Also ask them to run a sanity check: `print(type(candidates[0][0]))` and `len(candidates[0])`.
mia_ml: Workarounds while they migrate: 1) Server-side re-embed: send raw text and set embed_server=true (we encode with our 1024/1536 model depending on reranker). 2) Use an adapter: we can provide a small projection matrix service to map 512->1024 for POC but warn about quality. 3) Client upgrade: recommend our published embed models.
jules_se: For payload size: recommend chunking to 200 candidates per call for rerank-xl, or use the streaming rerank endpoint which accepts candidate streams. Also recommend Content-Encoding: gzip.
rachel_sales: They want a quick curl to try server-side embed route.
devin_infra: Example cURL (Halcyon's ops wanted an immediate test):
````bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"query\": \"How to migrate DB\", \"documents\": [\"doc1 text\",\"doc2 text\"], \"rerank_model\": \"rerank-xl\", \"embed_server\": true, \"max_candidates\": 200}'
````
This asks us to run embeddings then rerank. Expect added latency proportional to candidate count.
mia_ml: Performance tips: 1) Pre-filter with approximate ANN (embed client-side, do cosine top-K 300, then send for rerank). 2) For POC use rerank-base instead of XL. 3) Use our per-org caching for repeated queries.
rachel_sales: Halcyon asked about cost if we do server-side embed for the POC and whether Dedicated avoids 413s/rate limits.
devin_infra: POC pricing: sales typically offer credits or a temporary discount on embedding units. Recommend proposing a 30-day POC credit covering server-side embed costs up to $X. Dedicated removes noisy throttles but requires a contract. Ops/finance will confirm.
noah_sec: Security note: if they send raw customer data for server-side embed, we need to confirm data residency and PSAs. For Dedicated or private deploy, we'll need their signed NDA, SSO info, and the infosec questionnaire answered. I can drop the questionnaire and SOC2 report.
jules_se: Quick repro checklist to send to Halcyon: 1) Provide a single failing JSON payload file (sanitized). 2) Run `print(len(query_embedding))` and `print(type(candidates[0][0]))`. 3) If they base64 vectors, provide the decode routine. 4) Try chunking candidates to 200 and retry.
rachel_sales: Jordan ran len check: 512. He shared one failing payload and it looks like candidate vectors are arrays of floats (not base64).
devin_infra: Given that, options: A) Fast fix: use embed_server=true to move forward. B) Medium: client upgrade to our 1024 model. C) Experimental: we can stage a 512->1024 projection server for them during POC (quality disclaimer).
mia_ml: For projection: we can supply a pre-trained linear map from 512->1024 trained on public data samples, but it's approximate. If Halcyon cares about rank fidelity, do server-side re-embed.
rachel_sales: Jordan tried embed_server=true and passed the dims check, but they reported latency increased ~150ms per 100 candidates. They asked if we can cache embeddings on our side for repeated docs.
jules_se: We can enable doc-level caching for the POC org. Suggest setting a TTL of 24h for POC. I'll request ops to flip cache flag.
noah_sec: Also flagged contract step: they want an NDA before we ingest any PII. Send NDA and ask legal to review.
devin_infra: I'll also suggest they gzip requests and use chunking. Example python snippet to chunk candidates: `for chunk in chunks(candidates, 200): post_rerank(chunk)`
rachel_sales: Jordan asked about a possible 413 being caused by base64 bloat if they encode floats as binary. We asked them to stop base64 and send JSON arrays.
jules_se: Next actions I can take: 1) Enable embed_server & doc_cache flags for org-halcyon for 72h. 2) Provide patched client example and chunking guidance. 3) Draft POC credit note for finance.
rachel_sales: Thanks team. Jordan will validate latency and accuracy with embed_server flow and report back. I'll start contracting thread for NDA and the POC credit ask. :pray:
deploy_bot: Feature toggles updated: embed_server=true, doc_cache=true for org-halcyon at 2027-08-03T09:22:11Z
